data.exact_reserve_text:
Overall on an aggregate basis, reserve releases of GBP 1.4m net of reinsurance were made to prior year reserves during 2016. In 2015 there was a reserve strengthening of GBP 4.4m.

Overall the reserve release in 2016 was primarily generated by the Property account offset by a strengthening of the Professional Liability and Marine account reserves.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding opened at GBP 153.8m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 20.1m (13.1% of opening reserves), driven primarily by adverse development in the 2014 and 2012 underwriting years (notably in Professional Liability and Marine), partially offset by favourable development in earlier years and a release in Property on a gross basis. Net of reinsurance the Managing Agent reports an overall prior-year release of GBP 1.4m for 2016, reflecting significant reinsurance recoveries against the gross deterioration.

Overall the reserve release in 2016 was primarily generated by the Property account offset by a strengthening of the Professional Liability and Marine account reserves.
The largest two events were Hurricane Matthew and the Alberta wildfires

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 34). The Managing Agent's narrative only states a net prior-year release of GBP 1.4m (net of reinsurance). The gross strengthening (~GBP 20.06m) is derived from the triangle and reconciles to the net release through reinsurance recoveries not separately quantified in the report. Some numeric values were read from scanned images and rounded to three decimal places for millions; minor OCR/read uncertainty may exist.
